what.en: A fire is when something burns out of control. It needs heat, fuel, and air, and it can spread very fast.
what.fil: Ang sunog ay kapag may nasusunog na hindi na makontrol. Kailangan nito ng init, gatong, at hangin, at napakabilis nitong kumalat.

signs.en: Smoke, a burning smell, crackling sounds, or a fire alarm going off. Fires often start suddenly, so act fast.
signs.fil: Usok, amoy ng nasusunog, lagitik ng apoy, o tumutunog na fire alarm. Madalas biglaan ang sunog, kaya kumilos agad.

before.en: Never play with matches, lighters, or candles. Make a fire escape plan with your family and practice it.
before.fil: Huwag kailanman laruin ang posporo, lighter, o kandila. Gumawa ng fire escape plan kasama ang pamilya at ensayuhin ito.

during.en: Get out and stay out! Crawl low under smoke and cover your nose and mouth with a damp cloth. If your clothes catch fire: Stop, Drop, and Roll!
during.fil: Lumabas at huwag nang bumalik! Gumapang nang mababa sa ilalim ng usok at takpan ang ilong at bibig ng basang tela. Kapag nasunog ang damit: Stop, Drop, and Roll!

after.en: Once outside, call for help or tell an adult to call. Never go back inside until firefighters say it's safe, and get checked for injuries.
after.fil: Paglabas, humingi ng tulong o sabihan ang nakatatanda na tumawag. Huwag nang bumalik sa loob hangga't hindi sinasabi ng bumbero na ligtas na, at magpasuri kung nasaktan.

signoff.en: Remember: get out, stay out, and call for help!
signoff.fil: Tandaan: lumabas, huwag bumalik, at humingi ng tulong!
